newsitem.title: USA: DSC says court upholds judgment ruling.
newsitem.headline: DSC says court upholds judgment ruling.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp said on Monday that a U.S. Appeals Court upheld a $138 million judgment against Next Level Communications and its founders over the alleged theft of trade secrets.
The judge at the U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals in New Orleans entered a $127 million judgment in compensatory damages, plus $10 million in punitive damages to DSC, the company said.
An additional $1 million was added to the judgment, plus interest, related to this case, DSC said.
DSC said Thomas Eames and Peter Keeler, the founders of Next Level, were former employees of DSC.
Next Level is a wholly owned unit of General Instrument Corp, DSC said.
